has_concrete_runnable_target.label_zh: 是否存在具体可运行/可验证对象

instructions.question: Does `fact_card` name a concrete runnable or directly testable target (an open-source repository, installable package/CLI, reproducible command, testable prompt/workflow, or public web demo URL)?
instructions.focus: Pure opinions, news announcements without code/demo, or vague concepts without a concrete target must be false.

true.what: A specific repo, package, CLI, command, prompt workflow, or public interactive web URL is identified and testable.
examples: An open-source CLI benchmark repo on GitHub with install commands.
A public HuggingFace or Vercel web demo URL.

false.what: No runnable artifact or testable demo/prompt exists; only news, opinion, announcement, or closed product teaser.
false.not_for: A post containing a concrete GitHub repo, CLI tool, reproducible prompt, or public demo.

has_falsifiable_claim.label_zh: 是否包含可观测/可证伪结论或步骤

instructions.question: Does `fact_card` state concrete steps, behavior, or performance claims that an agent can run and observe to confirm or falsify within one test session?
instructions.focus: Require observable behavior, outputs, errors, latency, memory usage, or pass/fail functionality.

true.what: Steps or behavioral/performance claims can be verified directly by running commands, benchmarks, prompts, or UI interactions.

false.what: Claims are subjective, metaphysical, multi-month business forecasts, or impossible to observe in a technical test.

has_engineering_value.label_zh: 实测结果是否具备工程交流价值

instructions.question: Would running and verifying this target produce concrete technical findings (real measurements, compatibility edge cases, reproducibility verdict, or practical pitfalls) useful to software builders?
instructions.focus: Trivial one-liner jokes or empty hello-world spam have no engineering value.

true.what: Producing real numbers, compatibility notes, or a reproducibility report gives meaningful engineering insight.

false.what: Trivial toy spam, engagement bait, or uninformative marketing copy with no real engineering takeaway.

requires_paid_or_new_account.label_zh: 是否需要付费、绑卡、新注册或缺失凭据

instructions.question: Does verifying `fact_card` require paying money, binding a credit card, registering a brand-new user account/phone/KYC, or using an API key/credential absent from `capabilities`?
instructions.focus: Free open-source code, public unauthenticated web demos, and existing model CLIs in `capabilities.available_nodes.prompt_cli` do NOT trigger this blocker.

true.what: Testing requires a paid subscription/credit purchase not listed in `capabilities`, creating a new account/login wall, or private third-party credentials.

false.what: Public, free/open-source, or runs using only tools/frontier CLIs already listed in `capabilities` without new signups or payments.

requires_unavailable_hardware_or_os.label_zh: 是否超出本机与远程节点硬件/系统能力

instructions.question: Does verifying `fact_card` require hardware, VRAM, OS, or physical devices missing from `capabilities.available_nodes` (for instance multi-GPU H100 cluster, >8GB VRAM x86-only CUDA if not runnable on 61GB ARM64 Orin, Windows-only GUI, or physical mobile phones)?
instructions.focus: Remember `ubuntu_rtx5060` has 8GB VRAM x86_64 Docker+GPU, `orin_64g` has 61GB unified memory ARM64 CUDA 12.6, and `mac_headless` is Apple Silicon M1 Max 64GB CLI-only.

true.what: Requires hardware/OS unavailable across all listed nodes (e.g., 80GB H100, Windows-only driver, physical Android device).

false.what: Fits comfortably within at least one node in `capabilities.available_nodes`.

exceeds_120min_or_needs_offline_action.label_zh: 是否超过 2 小时时限或需要线下物理动作

instructions.question: Would a minimal faithful verification of `fact_card` realistically take more than 120 minutes total (e.g. downloading huge >40GB datasets, multi-hour model pretraining, waiting days) or require human offline physical actions?
instructions.focus: Evaluate realistic setup + test execution duration against the 120-minute ceiling.

true.what: Minimal verification exceeds 120 minutes or requires offline physical human intervention.

false.what: Setup plus meaningful test verification can complete cleanly well within 120 minutes.

endangers_hardware_or_host_stability.label_zh: 是否可能危及硬件或宿主机系统稳定性

instructions.question: Could running `fact_card` endanger physical hardware or host stability (overclocking, firmware/BIOS flashing, thermal burn-in, kernel-level modifications, privileged root host scripts outside containers, or stealing macOS desktop GUI focus)?
instructions.focus: Ordinary user-space builds/CLI/Docker containers inside `--rm` sandboxes are safe; host-mutating or hardware-stressing operations are blocked.

true.what: Involves flashing firmware, kernel modules, overclocking, destructive disk/network tests, or modifying host OS files outside a sandbox.

false.what: Runs safely inside an ephemeral user-space container, temp dir, or clean browser sandbox without risking hardware or host stability.

triggers_software_risk_control_or_tos_vi.label_zh: 是否涉及平台风控对抗或违反服务条款

instructions.question: Does verifying `fact_card` involve bypassing anti-bot checks/CAPTCHAs/paywalls/rate-limits, automated scraping of logged-in personal accounts, mass engagement/account-farming bots, or violating platform ToS in a way that risks account/IP bans?
instructions.focus: Reading public open-source code or public unauthenticated demo pages is safe; anything involving anti-detection, bypassing guards, or automating personal accounts is blocked.

true.what: Involves bypassing security/anti-bot/paywall/DRM checks, scraping gated platforms, or running engagement/farming automation.

false.what: Normal open-source local execution or visiting public unauthenticated web demos in a clean sandbox.

violates_ethics_business_or_law.label_zh: 是否违背人类伦理、商业道德或法律法规

instructions.question: Does the target or test involve malware, weaponized exploits, phishing, copyright piracy, unauthorized private-data extraction, fraud, harassment, or illegal/unethical activity?
instructions.focus: Treat any illegal, fraudulent, privacy-violating, or malicious tooling as strictly true (blocked).

true.what: Involves malicious, deceptive, privacy-violating, infringing, or illegal tooling or behavior.

false.what: Legitimate open-source software, engineering workflows, benchmarks, or lawful public web demos.
